fullContentHtml:
NTA JEE Mains Session I Online Form 2027 – Full Details

National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the Notifications for the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) Main 2027 Session I on its official website. The online application process for NTA JEE Main Session I Online Form 2027 has Started on 24 October 2026 & the Candidate can apply till 22 November 2026. The examination is going to conducted from 20 -28 January 2027. Candidates must check the Complete Details for NTA JEE Main Session I Online Form 2027 from the link provided below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 24 October 2026
  • Last Date : 22 November 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 22 November 2026
  • Exam Date : 20, 21, 22, 23, 24 & 28 January 2027
  • Admit Card Available : 03 Days Before Exam
  • Result Available : Will Be Updated Here Soon

Application Fee

  • For Paper I Only :
  • General (Male) : Rs. 1,000/-
  • EWS, OBC NCL (Male) : Rs. 900/-
  • General, OBC, EWS (Female) : Rs. 800/-
  • SC, ST (Male / Female) : Rs. 500/-
  • For Paper I & II Both :
  • General, OBC, EWS (Male) : Rs. 2,000/-
  • General, OBC, EWS (Female) : Rs. 1,600/-
  • SC, ST (Male / Female) : Rs. 1,000/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
